user_query: I want to stay updated on the latest news about climate change, narco in Mexico, and crypto. It would be great if you could provide me with the URL and title of each news article. Additionally, fetch the monthly data and search count for the keyword 'digital marketing'.

Fetch the latest news articles about narco in Mexico.

Compile the titles and URLs of the articles fetched in subtasks 1, 2, and 3.
